title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-U/B TUNNEL FILLER PNL & R.H. CARPET
summary: Turbo Hydra-matic (M40 3-speed automatic) cars: an underbody tunnel filler panel is bonded into the floor tunnel after cutting out the area inside the scribed line, and a matching right-hand carpet is used. The filler panel is bonded with bond "E" (Section A-A); no mechanical fasteners shown.

parts.name: PANEL-U/B TUNNEL FILLER
parts.name_expanded: Panel – underbody tunnel filler (floor tunnel patch for automatic)

fastening.note: Section A-A: tunnel filler panel [1] is bonded to the underbody along its flange (BOND "E"); the floor area inside the existing scribed line is cut out first.

notes: NOTE Cut & remove area within existing scribed line.
notes_internal: Bond "E" has no material legend on this sheet, so materials is empty and fastening.material is not set.
Carpet [2]: no fastening shown; it is laid over the tunnel area. A half-filled circle symbol follows the [2] callout; meaning not given on the sheet.
